observation_searches.purpose: Distinguish general policy application from Kessler-specific treatment
observation_searches.zero_result_limitations: A zero result shows only that the searched frozen corpus did not return a matching fragment; it does not prove absence of the event or source.

acceptance_cases.expected_behavior: Seek surrounding thread before treating the short email as dispositive.
Do not count documentary descendants of one interview as independent witnesses.
Preserve separately rooted corroboration without claiming statistical independence merely from distinct known roots.
Treat Helena's incorrect statement as attributable context, not privileged truth.
Detect that collection choices can bias apparent patterns and investigate the collector.
Represent an expected but uncollected source family separately from evidence content.
Treat repeated historical machine outputs with shared upstream context as dependent observations.
Keep speaker identity disputable and preserve assignment history.
Do not project current formal authority backward in time.
Keep formal authority and inferred practical influence distinct.
Do not infer culpability or credibility from political affiliation without connecting evidence.
Swapping affiliations must not change evidential interpretation absent connecting facts.
Retrieve a decision-relevant fragment outside the initial source packet when current hypotheses point to it.
Prefer a low-cost observation when plausible answers separate important hypotheses and can change a decision.
Represent high information value separately from acquisition cost and human authorization.
Treat byte/hash integrity after collection as distinct from authenticity before collection.
